metric: Custom BigQuery edge cases (three-valued logic, precedence, CTEs, DISTINCT, QUALIFY, SAFE_, casts, UNNEST, PIVOT) plus seeded fuzz cases; accepted rewrites are executed in DuckDB before and after and compared.
caveats: All cases are custom (379 hand-written, 588 seeded fuzz), none from a public benchmark. Held-out: 662 fresh-seed fuzz cases, 395 rewritten, 0 wrong. Baseline before fixes: 1 wrong (lifting dropped UNPIVOT, and the prover called it equivalent). A rewrite suite can pass by changing nothing; 539 declined (531 with lifting, plus 1 query DuckDB cannot execute, so it gets no verdict). Re-measured on master 4d294afd (sqlglot 30.21): 434 to 435 rewritten, 0 wrong; the semantic pipeline row in the docs was not re-measured. Literal folds spot-checked on real BigQuery. Fell from 435 when the parser check began refusing 18 fuzz cases whose text BigQuery rejects or reads differently from sqlglot (docs/parser-checks.md).
correctness: 0 behaviour-changing accepted rewrites; checked by executing both versions in DuckDB
coverage_of: The 966 of the 967 cases with a coverage outcome; the other one is not executable in DuckDB, so it gets no verdict.
